title: Durable Workflow Graph with Approval and Exactly-Once Effects
instructions: Implement `Ledger` and the `Graph` engine in `workflow.py` (`END`, the type aliases and `RunStatus` are provided): nodes return partial updates merged through per-key reducers, edges are static or conditional, and a JSON checkpoint is written after every node. The engine pauses before nodes listed in `interrupt_before`, resumes across processes sharing only the store, and retries a crashed node without a second approval or a second side effect.

evidence.label: Reducers append, other keys overwrite, and nodes get a deep copy of the state
Ledger.run_once runs each effect at most once per key
A conditional edge can skip the refund branch
A router target that is not a node raises ValueError
A paused run resumes from a new Graph instance sharing only the store
A crash after a side effect retries without a second charge
A crash after approval does not ask for approval again
A finished thread returns immediately and a new thread needs an entry node
